# apple_app_clip_domain_status (Data Source)

Reads whether the associated domains of a build's App Clip are reachable and set up correctly, which App Clip invocation URLs depend on. App Store Connect reports a cache status and a debug status for each domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_clip_domain_status" "clip" {
  build_bundle_id = local.app_clip_bundle_id
}

output "invalid_app_clip_domains" {
  value = [for d in data.apple_app_clip_domain_status.clip.cache_domains : d.domain if !d.is_valid]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip's build bundle; see `data.apple_build_bundles`.

### Read-Only

- `cache_domains` (Attributes List) The App Clip's associated domains with their cache status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cache_domains))
- `cache_last_updated_date` (String) When the cache status was last updated.
- `debug_domains` (Attributes List) The App Clip's associated domains with their debug status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--debug_domains))
- `debug_last_updated_date` (String) When the debug status was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--cache_domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cache_domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The associated domain.
- `error_code` (String) Why the association is invalid, e.g. `CANNOT_REACH_AASA_FILE`, `BAD_JSON_CONTENT` or `INVALID_ENTITLEMENT_UNKNOWN_ID`. Null for a valid domain.
- `is_valid` (Boolean) Whether the domain's association with the App Clip is valid.
- `last_updated_date` (String) When the domain was last checked.


<a id="nestedatt--debug_domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `debug_domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The associated domain.
- `error_code` (String) Why the association is invalid, e.g. `CANNOT_REACH_AASA_FILE`, `BAD_JSON_CONTENT` or `INVALID_ENTITLEMENT_UNKNOWN_ID`. Null for a valid domain.
- `is_valid` (Boolean) Whether the domain's association with the App Clip is valid.
- `last_updated_date` (String) When the domain was last checked.
